rationale: Open catalogue layer over YouControl: mine once to enumerate UA banks/payment firms by KVED, not a continuous signal feed.
Root open-data aggregator republishing USREOU and financial statements for banking/payment legal entities; durable monitorable parent.
API docs describing machine-readable registers; read once to build the pipeline, no ongoing signal.
Per-EDRPOU pages for major UA banks plus Prozorro procurement links; standalone monitorable platform.
Valuable KVED/financial segmentation aimed at banks and financial-monitoring entities, but a commercial platform likely behind registration.
Authoritative Ministry of Justice ЄДР free search — ground truth for every bank and payment institution; failed check is soft only.
Bulk machine-readable USREOU dataset with weekly updates — best enumerator of banking/payment entities and ownership change.
NAIS is the register operator and alternative publication point for ЄДР open-data files and format changes.
Free LEI search giving authoritative identity records for UA financial entities and the EDRPOU-to-international key.
Bulk LEI Level 1/2 golden copy plus API — machine-readable ownership backbone for UA bank groups and foreign-owned PSPs.
Static LOU/issuer directory; mine once to understand UA LEI coverage bias, then archive.
Third-party mirror of GLEIF records; redundant given direct GLEIF search and bulk files.
Statutory NSSMC issuer disclosure archive holding UA banks' annual reports and financial statements independently of bank sites.
NSSMC public database with ESKRIN feed and 10%+ significant-stake register — direct source on bank shareholder structure.
Credit-bureau register front-end with per-bank pages; distinctive signal layer but access/licence terms unclear.
Single Diia.Business news item on ЄДР access restoration — useful evidence; monitor the parent news feed instead.
Vendor newsroom tracking disclosure availability; standalone feed but URL failed and value is secondary — recheck liveness.
Analytics sub-page of opendatabot.ua, already covered by monitoring the parent domain.
Derzhstat EDRPOU statistical register layer is in scope for KVED reconciliation, but URL check failed — verify reachability.
CDX API enumerates archived URLs/PDFs under dead UA bank and PSP domains; highest-leverage recovery endpoint despite soft failed check.
Availability API triages bank/PSP disclosure URLs into live, dead-but-archived, never-captured; cheap and public.
Wartime .ua WARC repository with incidental bank coverage; mine seed lists and methodology once rather than monitor.
Curated Ukraine collections with their own CDX API surfacing captures the public Wayback front-end hides.
Second-opinion on-demand archive holding ad-hoc captures of UA bank/PSP press releases missed by IA.
NBU reorganisation/liquidation history since 2014 is the authoritative actor and continuity register for the cell.
DGF custodian pages preserve liquidation-stage reporting and asset data for failed banks after their own sites die.
Dated archive of DGF member-bank lists; diffing snapshots yields an exact timeline of the banking population.
